work.description: Named address to the bishop of Città di Castello, restoration of the parish and dispensation from concursus for Joseph Core survive through the complete closing. Source citation1193 is VII’s note1 although emitted after VIII’s title; note2 at1194 belongs VIII. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF1100–1100; the source closing at LF1174–1177 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima septima martii mil- lesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pontifica- tus Nostri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
